title: Josh Alxndr Drops New Single "2037" ft. J. Razzi
htmlContent:
Charlotte-based artist Josh Alxndr has released a new single, "2037," featuring J. Razzi, the first track from his upcoming project. "2037" touches on nostalgia and longing for a time that's already passed, yet also looking forward to the future. The song showcases the artist's versatility with a smooth, laid-back beat paired with reflective lyrics.

With his debut release, "Dreams That Follow Me," in late 2022, Josh Alxndr quickly gained attention for his emotionally charged lyrics and unique sound. The new single "2037" continues to build on that momentum, highlighting the artist's growth and evolution.

Listeners can expect more great things from Josh Alxndr in the future as he continues to explore new sounds and themes in his music. "2037" is an excellent addition to any chill playlist, so be sure to give it a listen and share it with your friends.
